digest.component_or_area: test harness - nested pytest child process isolation
propositions: Nested pytest child process omits --basetemp argument, causing it to join the user-global numbered temp root and triggering synchronous recursive cleanup of unrelated stale entries during session finish after test completion, consuming time beyond the 90-second timeout.

Controlled filesystem poisoning with 400,000 stale entries demonstrated that shared-root child cleanup takes 10.8s versus 0.882s with private basetemp, proving cleanup cost scales with retained entries.

The repair passes a caller-owned tmp_path/nested-pytest basetemp to the nested pytest child, isolating session-finish cleanup while preserving ambient tracker HEAD/directories and test selection semantics.

Real-subprocess regression test verifies the fix by sentinel preservation: before the fix nested pytest deleted another run's sentinel (RED), after the fix the sentinel survives (GREEN), and omitting basetemp again returns to RED.
